title: main: thread root rules client MUST inconsistent with server SHOULD validate
description: Thread model section says 'Clients MUST follow these rules. Servers SHOULD validate them and MAY correct threadRootId.' If servers only SHOULD validate and MAY correct, the client MUST has no enforcement backstop — a compliant server may accept any threadRootId. Decision: either make server validation MUST (giving the client MUST teeth), or downgrade client to SHOULD (accepting that thread structure is best-effort).
close_reason: Downgraded client MUST to SHOULD, consistent with server SHOULD validate. Added explicit description of the consequence: message won't appear in threadRootId-filtered queries and replyCount won't reflect correctly — broken UI threading but no delivery or integrity impact.
